May contain spoilers from Sky King's Tomb **Source** [Pathfinder #193: Mantle of Gold](/Sources.aspx?ID=206) pg. 83 **Usage** incorporated into armor **Bulk** L --- Made from glossy, nearly black adamantine, this large fragment of a plate armor vambrace provides little protection on its own. However, when incorporated into an intact suit of armor, it functions as a [_+1 armor potency_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=278) rune.
**Forming the Bond** The PCs complete the [rite of repatriation](/Rituals.aspx?ID=105).
**Advancing the Bond** Survive (or even triumph against) seemingly impossible odds.
**Minor Gifts** [beginner's luck](/Relics.aspx?ID=97), [ease burden](/Relics.aspx?ID=25), [shattered earth](/Relics.aspx?ID=27)
**Major Gifts** [raise ramparts](/Relics.aspx?ID=28), [steal luck](/Relics.aspx?ID=101)
name: Adamantine Echo
